answer: Filling 78 aliases thus means producing 78 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. Because the knoll count is verified against the velvet text itself, the oasis audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 7 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. That is 12 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
